storage: Store in an airtight jar at room temperature, away from moisture and heat, for up to 6–12 months. A bay leaf or a few dried red chillies in the jar is a common home trick against weevils; in humid Mumbai monsoon months, keeping a small stock or refrigerating it helps. Soaked moong keeps 1 day in the fridge; the ground batter 1–2 days in the fridge (dish file note: it turns sour as it is not meant to ferment).
looksLike: Small, oval, olive-green beans about 4 mm long, each with a tiny white mark (the hilum) on one side. The green skin is left on, which is what separates it from split yellow moong dal.
shelfLife: About 6–12 months unopened in a dry place (check the pack's best-before date). Older beans take longer to soak and cook.
substitutes: Split green moong with skin (chilka moong)

usedIn.raw: 60 g dry (about ⅓ cup), soaked and ground with 10 g raw rice
